turns.question: What should I cook tonight in Pretoria for two? I have about an hour and I shop at PnP. Give me the recipe and what it'll cost.
turns.answer:
Ek gee dit gou vir my kok; hy's nou-nou terug met 'n antwoord.My kok is terug, hier is wat hy gekry het:

Serves 2 · about 35 minutes

**The dish**
A one-pot chicken curry with potatoes and baby carrots, ready in about 35 minutes, so it fits tonight's hour. It feeds two comfortably and uses cheap cuts and one jar of curry paste.

![Maklike Kerrie Hoender Resep](https://idata.hiloved.com/imgs/71c8af47bc3e39b6-1024x681.jpg)

### Recipe

Serves 2 · about 35 minutes

1. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok or deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the chopped onion until soft and see-through.
2. Stir in the curry paste and fry until fragrant. (If you use curry powder instead, add a little water to make a paste.)
3. Add the chicken pieces and stir-fry for about 5 minutes until browned and coated in the curry paste.
4. Add the carrots and potatoes, stir for a minute, then add the stock, sugar, salt and pepper.
5. Cover and simmer on low for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken and potatoes are cooked through.
6. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Sprinkle with ground coriander if you like, and serve.

Link: https://af.hiloved.com/maklike-kerrie-hoender-resep/
